name: craft-capability
description: Standalone discovery and governance for Skills, MCP tools, Workflows, and adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and rank capabilities without activating all tools.
interface.longDescription: Scan and logically deduplicate capability sources, preserve provenance, audit health and trust, and recommend the smallest task-relevant activation set.
defaultPrompt: Find the smallest healthy capability set for this goal; do not activate or execute it yet.
